expected: We are Team Skaar, from Mérida, Mexico. Our challenge: Space Mission Design Game. Students rarely see how a real mission is designed. So we built Margin Zero: mission design with zero margin for error. Pick a contract. Build a rocket on a tight budget. Launch, and fly it yourself. Space fights back, modeled on NASA and JPL open data. Every flight ends with a debrief of what went wrong. Training the next generation of mission designers.
